summary: iter121 duplicate-cleanup-on-relink verified end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass against public preview URL — coach/staff/athlete re-link to a DIFFERENT existing roster entry deletes the previously auto-created duplicate row (net roster count -1), target row gets linked_id=user + email, athlete_chat_links for the removed row are purged (athlete case), same-id relink is a no-op (no accidental delete), and no-athlete_roster_id path still creates a fresh row without wrongly deleting unrelated linked_id rows. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, demo owner): ACTIVE member row now renders a 'Link / edit' button (testID edit-<user_id>). Tapping it opens the assign modal titled 'Update <name>' pre-filled with the current role (Coach chip highlighted) and displaying the picker. Picking a different profile (Coach Maria) and Confirm cleanly updates the row to 'Coach · for Coach Maria', closes the modal, and the roster count went from 10 -> 9 in the DB (duplicate deleted). Regression: pending member row still shows 'Assign role' button (testID assign-<uid>) and flow works. No React Native deprecated packages or SafeAreaView issues detected in touched files.
critical_code_review_comments: team_members.py:312-319 duplicate-cleanup query is scoped to (owner_id, linked_id=user, id != target) and correctly runs only when role in coach/staff/athlete AND athlete_roster_id was supplied AND a target was resolved — good guardrails, no accidental deletes on the no-link path or on parent role.

Pre-existing (out of scope): re-linking to an existing roster row silently OVERWRITES that row's prior linked_id (e.g. Coach Maria was linked to another user before; after relink to a new joiner, the old user is now orphaned from the roster). This is the documented behavior of the consolidation flow (iter119) but worth surfacing if the product wants a warning.
seed_data_creation: Backend test creates a throwaway TEST_owner121 signup + 3 seeded roster entries (coach/staff/athlete) per module and cleans them up. UI test creates a throwaway joiner_*@t.com signup, joins the demo owner's team, exercises the Link / edit flow, then removes the throwaway user and restores Coach Maria's original linked_id.
